use_case_name: Respond to a Second-Chance Purchase Offer

claims.content: To allow a customer to respond to a second-chance purchase offer.

goal.raw_text: To allow a customer to respond to a second-chance purchase offer.

claims.content: Customer
The customer has previously participated in an auction for an item but did not win.
A second-chance offer has been generated and is available to the customer.
The customer is logged into their account on the JTV Auctions website.
The customer receives a notification of a second-chance purchase offer for an item they previously bid on but did not win.

trigger.raw_text: The customer receives a notification of a second-chance purchase offer for an item they previously bid on but did not win.

claims.content: The customer logs into their account on the JTV Auctions website.
The customer navigates to the 'My Account Page' from the site diagram's customer-facing pages.
The customer accesses their bid history or watch list to view items they previously bid on but did not win.
The system displays available second-chance purchase offers for eligible items in the customer’s account interface.
The customer selects a second-chance offer and proceeds to respond (accept or decline).
If accepted, the system processes the purchase and updates the customer’s order status.
At step 4, if the customer declines the second-chance purchase offer, the system removes the offer from the available list and returns the customer to their account dashboard.
At step 5, if the customer accepts the offer but payment processing fails, the system notifies the customer of the failure and allows them to retry or cancel the transaction.
If the customer attempts to access a second-chance offer that has expired or is no longer valid, the system displays a 'No Results Search Page' indicating the item is unavailable.
If the customer's session times out while responding to the offer, the system redirects the user to the 'Sign-in Page' to re-authenticate before proceeding.
The customer’s order status is updated to reflect the successful purchase of the item via second-chance offer.
If the customer declines the offer, the system removes it from the available list and returns the user to their account dashboard.
In case of payment failure after acceptance, the system notifies the customer and allows retry or cancellation.
If the offer is expired or invalid, the system displays a 'No Results Search Page' indicating unavailability.
If session times out during response, the system redirects to 'Sign-in Page' for re-authentication.
